rows.commentary: Straightens it early, power comes in early, goes again.
Defends the inside, rear moves slightly, carries on.
Leaves no space, small correction on throttle, stays under control.
Checks the rear once, keeps it together, then a twitch on entry.
Gets the power down firmly at 5000 RPM, maintaining momentum.
ROUND IT GOES! then avoids anything worse.
Hits the anchors, brakes complaining at 80 km/h, recovers on exit.
Catches a slip, reinsurges with a correction, momentum held.
